comparison.objective: Meter 10 mL of syrup into a held dosing cup and replace both vessels.
comparison.physical_skill: Level vessel holding, controlled pouring, flow cutoff, and spill avoidance—not dry-particle sifting.
comparison.success_condition: 9–11 mL dose, ≤0.5 mL spill, cup and bottle placed and released for 1 s; explicit overdose/spill failures.
comparison.reason: Tests liquid metering and pour control; shared tilt and receiver concepts do not establish overlap.
